calculation_evidence.predicate: SELECT id FROM p WHERE ((isodow(posting_date)+6)%7) IN (5,6)
SELECT id FROM p WHERE posting_date IN (NULL)
SELECT id FROM p WHERE posting_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND (extract(hour FROM timezone('UTC',posting_timestamp)) < 0 OR extract(hour FROM timezone('UTC',posting_timestamp)) >= 24)
SELECT id FROM p WHERE amount >= 10000 AND amount % 10000=0
SELECT p.id FROM p JOIN signatures s USING(journal_ref) WHERE s.sig IN (SELECT sig FROM signatures GROUP BY sig HAVING count(*)>1)

SELECT p.id FROM p JOIN (SELECT *, lag(debit) OVER w prev_debit,lag(posting_date) OVER w prev_date,lag(sig) OVER w prev_sig FROM signatures WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY accounts ORDER BY debit,posting_date,journal_ref)) s USING(journal_ref) WHERE s.debit>0 AND abs(s.debit-s.prev_debit)<=s.debit*0.01 AND abs(date_diff('day',s.posting_date,s.prev_date))<=3 AND s.sig<>s.prev_sig
